run_codec_test: run the audio codec test with an encoder and decoder on a wav dataset subset
run_encode_decode: run the encode and decode pipeline on audio data using the TestMain class
load_encoder_model: load a symAudioDec encoder model from a checkpoint file for audio encoding
load_decoder_model: load a symAudioDec or HiFiGAN decoder model from a checkpoint file for audio decoding
encode_audio: encode audio samples into quantized latent representations using the encoder and quantizer
